correctness.rationale: PASS: Simultaneous functional dependency x->y and inclusion pi_x subset pi_y force every finite consistent nonempty subrelation to be a permutation on its used vertices. A strict extension is a cycle on unused vertices; maximality iff unused vertices lie in at most one part. Allowed permutations exist exactly for 2 max(s_i)<=sum(s_i), by cyclic rotation across contiguous part blocks. Rook inclusion-exclusion yields D(s), and omitting t vertices from one part gives the exact labelled generating polynomial. Omissions from largest part realize every integer from max(n-a1,2 a2) through min(n,2(n-a1)), and other omission choices lie within. Independently checked six profiles and full example (3,2,2) polynomial 4z^4+48z^5+384z^6+288z^7.
residual_risks: Statement restricted to complete bidirected cross-part relation and exactly one FD and one ID; arbitrary databases differ.
